description: Launch a Modal serverless function via Dagster Pipes and materialize the emitted asset(s) with the metadata the Modal function reports back. Streams logs + structured metadata + AssetMaterialization events over Pipes during the run — richer observability than the fire-and-track ModalAssetComponent. Requires the user's Modal function to open a `dagster_pipes.open_dagster_pipes()` context.

outputs.description: One primary asset whose materialization is triggered by the Modal function's PipesContext.report_asset_materialization(). Function can also emit additional asset materializations.

app_file.label: App File
app_file.description: Path (relative to Dagster process CWD) to the Python file defining the Modal app + function.

function_args.label: Function Args
function_args.description: Kwargs forwarded to the Modal function via CLI flags (--key=value).

modal_token_id_env_var.label: Modal Token ID Env Var
modal_token_id_env_var.description: Optional — overrides MODAL_TOKEN_ID for the subprocess.

modal_token_secret_env_var.label: Modal Token Secret Env Var
modal_token_secret_env_var.description: Optional — overrides MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET for the subprocess.

name: Modal Pipes Asset
